rationale: Clear motor vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's car and injuries sustained as a result of the accident.
claim_summary: Policyholder rear-ended at red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am; vehicle totaled (trunk crushed into back seat). Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's information documented on police report. Urgent on-site adjuster attention recommended due to severity and injuries.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision at red light; other vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: Filed; other driver's insurance info on report
